personality_one_liner: A premium, human, energetic training companion. Dark charcoal and chartreuse stay. Data is honest. Motion is short. The staff console is a separate system.

color.note: Canonical member tokens are frontend/src/palette.ts, re-exported by frontend/src/theme.ts. #D4FF00, #121212, and Satoshi are retired. Saturated success/error/info/warning are marks, not small text.

typography.license: SIL Open Font License. Files live in frontend/assets/fonts. Do not load Inter or Satoshi from a CDN.

spacing.rule: Maintain tight data density but obvious hierarchy. Use 'sm' (8) and 'md' (12) for inner-card grouping, and 'lg' (16) for outer screen margins.

radius_tokens.note: These numbers are shared with the staff console through frontend/src/theme.ts spacing and radius. Do not change them without checking staff layout.

shadow_tier: flat data cards; one raised tier for the session hero and sheets

do's: Use a short static chartreuse wash on the session hero only.
Separate surfaces with borders and one elevation step for the hero and sheets.
dont's: Do not use glass for data cards, lists, form fields, biomarkers, or the logger.
Do not run continuous decorative motion.

screens.name: Onboarding / Auth
screens.purpose: High-impact entry with dark moody visuals framing email/password fields.
screens.layout: Ground field with the existing app icon marked Placeholder, then a scrim into the form. Inputs sit in the lower half. Pill primary buttons use brand.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: A daily command center summarizing workouts, biomarkers, and wearable recovery metrics at a glance.

states.loading: Skeleton meter rows and card outlines
states.empty: Stable strain, recovery, and sleep slots read Not connected. Missing values stay an em dash.
states.error: Unable to fetch data with a retry tap target

screens.layout: Night Studio ledger. Session stage first. Strain, recovery, and sleep are quiet meter rows. HRV and resting heart rate sit in the same card. Session load lives on the training week, not in a fourth dial.

screens.name: Workouts
screens.purpose: Library and history of sessions, focusing on tracking live performance and exploring new exercises.

states.empty: Iconography indicating no recent workouts, CTA to 'Start First Workout'

screens.layout: Sessions and Library segments. Exercise rows use a placeholder poster plate. The new-session button is a solid brand bar, not a glass overlay.

screens.name: Biomarkers
screens.purpose: Deep dive into health analytics, blood markers, and long-term wearable metric trends.
screens.layout: Intense data-viz screen. Line charts and sparklines for metric timelines. Use brandPrimary and warning/error colors to indicate zone thresholds (e.g., green for good HRV, orange for high stress).

screens.name: Community & Coaching
screens.purpose: Social feed of workouts, group sessions, and coach discovery.

states.empty: Message to 'Follow athletes or find a coach'

screens.layout: Tabbed view (Feed / Coaches). Feed uses card-based layout with kudos/comments under workout maps/metrics. Coaches view uses 2-col grid for coach profiles. Heavy use of initial avatars or fetched real-logos for clubs.

onboarding_hero.alt: Runner in crouched starting position on track, ready to sprint

premium_backdrop.alt: Abstract neon green wavy texture on black

coach_placeholder.alt: Focused male athlete in dark gym setting

staff_console.scope: frontend/staff and frontend/src/components/admin only. Member screens keep frontend/src/theme.ts.
staff_console.brand_decision: color.brand #D4FF00 in this file is not what the app renders. theme.ts and the staff console both use #D6E35A. Chartreuse is only the primary action, the selected nav item, and key queue links. The ground stays in the #101418 family. Do not reintroduce #D4FF00 or paint chrome with the accent.

typography.display: Barlow Condensed, OFL, bundled at frontend/assets/fonts
typography.not_used: Satoshi is a commercial Fontshare face and is not licensed in this repository. Inter is the member web fallback only.

staff_console.shadows: Floating chrome only: sidebar, confirm dialog, sign-in card. Queues, tables, and accounting rows stay flat.
staff_console.glass: Not used on tables, accounting figures, or moderation detail.
staff_console.motion: 180ms ironflow-rise on the main pane and sign-in. prefers-reduced-motion removes the travel.
staff_console.imagery_3d: No remote photos and no WebGL. Sign-in uses an inline SVG mark on a local gradient.
staff_console.navigation: Grouped sidebar from 1080px. Below that, one horizontal rail of the same admin-tab test ids. No extra click to reach a section.

member_system.name: IRONFLOW MOTION — Athletic Intelligence
principles: Premium, human, and energetic. Not generic SaaS and not neon gaming.
Unknown is not zero. A recorded zero is labeled. Sample data is never shown as live.
Chartreuse is the primary action and the selected tab.
One raised session hero. Data rows stay flat with borders.
Motion is a short fade. Reduced motion removes it. No looping decoration.
Imagery belongs on community, coaches, and onboarding. The logger, labs, and charts stay focused.
Reference ranges and readiness are educational, not a diagnosis.

instructions_to_main_agent: Staff console: follow staff_console only. Member screens follow palette.ts and theme.ts. Do not reapply retired #D4FF00, #121212, Satoshi, or zero-shadow rules to either product.
Do not import member colors into frontend/staff or frontend/src/components/admin. Staff tabs that need color use staffColors.
Spacing and radius in theme.ts are shared with staff layout. Keep the numeric scale.
Missing wearable and readiness values render as unknown. Do not coerce them with ?? 0.
Bundled OFL fonts only: Barlow Condensed for display, Barlow for text, Space Mono for figures.
